title.narrative: Energy Supply Improvement Investment Program Tranche 2 (Formerly Multitranche Financing Facility II: Energy Development 2014-2023)

description.narrative: The project will expand power imports from Turkmenistan through an asynchronous power interconnection, establish a unified power grid in Afghanistan, and extend the power grid into central Afghanistan. The 500-MW converter station will allow Turkmen power into the Afghan grid under the ten-year power purchase and sales agreement signed in November 2015. The Doshi-Bamyan line will expand the grid to eight additional provinces, distribute power to nearly 150,000 people, and provide redundancy to the existing transmission network. The project has transmission and distribution system linkages with several projects assisted by ADB and other development partners. The project is fully aligned with the National Energy Supply Program of the Government of Afghanistan.
Increased supply of imported and indigenous power

Electrification rate increased to 50% by 2028 Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Under implementation. 1. The contract for 20,000 new household connections in Bamyan province was awarded to Shyama Power for $24,132,596.88 on 22 April 2018 and it was effective on 17 October 2018. The Topographical and Electrical survey and SS layout has been completed and design work works is ongoing. Overall progress of the project is 56% as of 31 July 2021. 2. 220/20 kV Bamyan Substation and expansion of 220/20 kV Doshi Substation was awarded to XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER with total amount of contract 10,694,974.19 on 22 April 2018. The Topographical and Electrical survey and SS layout has been completed Design and civil work is ongoing. The design of Doshi substation is ongoing and the physical work has already commenced. Detailed survey is completed for distribution network while design, route, transformer sizing and sag tension is ongoing. The overall progress is about 69% as of 31 July 2021. 3. 500-kV high voltage DC back to back converter station at Dashte Alwan - The bid opening for the 500-kV high voltage direct current back-to-back converter station near Pul-e Khumri (Dasht-e-Alwan) was held in 18 March 2019. The bid evaluation was submitted to ADB by DABS. The tender has been cancelled.
In mid-August 2021, the government was changed and works were suspended. It is likely that completion of works will be delayed. ADB is closely monitoring and evaluating the situation. Data Source: a. Afghanistan CSO publications b. DABS annual report c. Publications by international development partners d. Quarterly reports by Interministerial Commission for Energy
